slots.notes: Fullscreen looping, muted, autoplaying (playsInline) hero background video filling the rounded card via absolute inset-0 object-cover; all content (nav, headline, contact form) sits above it at z-10. Supply a silent seamless-looping reel; framing should survive object-cover crop at any viewport ratio.

32x32 brand logo mark in the glass pill navbar, authored inline as a viewBox="0 0 256 256" SVG with two black-filled paths forming a stylized 'M' (path data hardcoded in JSX). Replace with the brand mark; supply transparent (sits on a translucent white pill) and note the fill is a hardcoded black, so retint/replacement is a markup edit, not a token flip.

Four 32x32 rounded-xl social buttons in the contact card's email row, each a lucide-react icon at size 13 on a pastel tint chip: Twitter (gray-100/gray-800), Circle (pink-100/pink-500), Instagram (orange-100/orange-400), Linkedin (blue-100/blue-600). Supply as currentColor-driven glyphs; both the icon color and its chip background are hardcoded Tailwind utilities per button, so rebranding the social palette is a per-button class edit.

mechanic: A single viewport-locked rounded card with a fullscreen object-cover looping video background, over which a glassmorphic backdrop-blur pill navbar sits at top and a bottom-anchored row pairs a drop-shadowed white headline (one word swapped to italic Instrument Serif) with a white contact-form card whose submit fakes a 1s async delay then swaps the form for a green-check success state; all motion is Tailwind hover/focus/transition utilities plus multi-select service-chip toggles, no animation library.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS (standard config scanning ./index.html + ./src) as a single-file App.tsx component with a SocialBtn helper; lucide-react for icons; Inter + Instrument Serif loaded via Google Fonts @import in src/index.css with a global * { font-family:'Inter' } rule.
reskinNotes:
Every color is a hardcoded Tailwind utility class rather than a CSS token, so reskinning is find-replace across markup, not editing variables: the accent blue lives as text-blue-600 (mailto link) and the blue-100/blue-600 LinkedIn chip; neutrals are gray-50/100/200/400/700/800/900 and bg-white/60; the four social chips bake their own pastel pairs (pink-100/500, orange-100/400, blue-100/600); the success state uses bg-green-50. The logo is an inline two-path SVG with black fill hardcoded in JSX. The 'products' accent word is a with an inline style object (fontFamily 'Instrument Serif', italic, 400) rather than a class, so the accent font binding is buried in markup. Emoji are baked into copy (the 'Say hello! 👋' heading and the success '✓' check). ALL copy is hardcoded inline including the SERVICES array (9 fixed chip labels) and the VIDEO_URL/mailto/nav strings; the headline uses a hardcoded
line break and drop-shadow tuned to the white-on-video treatment, so a brand font or longer copy can shift the intended two-line composition.
